رابط مساحة لعرض المنتجات التقنية والخدما: RABT is a space to list technology products and digital services and discuss them within Jordan. This local edition is under development. Sample catalog entries, characters and generated images are illustrative, not confirmed commercial offers. A purchase request does not confirm availability, sale or shipping and does not process an online payment.
قدّم بيانات صحيحة واحفظ سرية كلمة المرور: Provide accurate information and keep your password private. Independent account use is for people aged 18 or over; a guardian's supervision is required where applicable by law. You are responsible for your posted content and your right to publish it. Demo accounts are for exploration; do not enter sensitive information.
يُحظر الاحتيال، والإعلانات المضللة، وانت: Fraud, misleading advertisements, intellectual property infringement, unlawful disclosure of others' data, and stolen, counterfeit or prohibited goods are not permitted. Clearly state the condition and defects of used items and the price in Jordanian dinars. The platform may restrict violating content after review. Appeals can be submitted through the contact form.
يتعين على البائع توضيح هويته وصفته التجا: Before a sale, sellers must explain their identity and commercial capacity, product specifications, total costs, shipping, applicable taxes and warranty. Agree delivery terms and inspect used goods. An account badge or product image is not certification or a warranty from RABT. These terms do not exclude mandatory consumer rights or liabilities imposed by law.
للإبلاغ عن محتوى أو مشكلة، استخدم صفحة ا: Use the contact page to report content or a problem and include the order number or listing link. You retain the right to approach the competent authorities and courts. The service is subject to applicable Jordanian law; jurisdiction is determined by the legal rules without restricting consumer rights.
تنشر التعديلات الجوهرية بتاريخ واضح، وتُ: Material changes are published with a clear date. New consent is requested where the nature of the change requires it. Changes do not apply retroactively to existing rights. Before commercial launch, complete the registered operator's details, address and contact channels and have the texts reviewed by a Jordanian specialist.

نحفظ بيانات الحساب التي تقدمها: الاسم وا: We store the account information you provide: name, email, phone, city, store details and optional image, to operate your account and listings. We also store purchase request details and contact messages to handle them. Passwords are stored as salted derived hashes, never in plain text. We do not collect payment card numbers or use external advertising or analytics tools in this edition.
يظهر اسم البائع أو المتجر والمدينة ووصفه: Visitors can see the seller or store name, city, description and listings. Public interfaces do not expose your account email or phone. When you confirm a request and consent, relevant sellers see your name, phone and email to discuss it. Each seller sees only their own products and subtotal, not the rest of the cart. Orders and contact details are not visible to visitors or unrelated accounts. Generated images and sample characters are identified as illustrative.
تطلب النماذج موافقة واضحة غير محددة مسبق: Forms request clear, unchecked consent for the described processing. You may request access, a copy, correction or deletion of your data, object or withdraw consent subject to applicable law and restrictions, using the contact form and describing your privacy request. You can update account details in settings. We verify identity before responding to data requests without asking for your password. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing and may stop features that depend on the data.
في التشغيل المحلي تُخزن البيانات في ملف: During local operation, data is stored in a private file under .data on the server computer and persists after restart. It is retained until deletion is requested or performed operationally. The operator currently handles deletion and review manually. Forms do not automatically transfer data externally or send email. Retention periods, hosting location and the basis for any cross-border transfers must be specified before commercial deployment.
نستخدم ملف ارتباط ضروريًا للجلسة لمدة تص: We use a necessary session cookie lasting up to 30 days and browser local storage for language and theme preferences. There are no marketing trackers. The session contains a random identifier protected from JavaScript access. HTTPS must be enabled when hosting to protect the connection. You can clear browser preferences or sign out of your account.
للملاحظات وطلبات الخصوصية استخدم نموذج ا: Use the contact form for privacy questions and requests. This edition does not yet provide a registered operator's details. The controller's name, address, contact channels and response periods must be completed before commercial launch. You retain the right to complain to the Personal Data Protection Directorate at the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship under its official procedures.
Know your rights before agreeing to buy.
يحفظ رابط طلبات اهتمام فقط. لا نحصل دفعا: RABT currently saves purchase requests only. We do not collect payments or issue sales or shipping confirmations, so the platform does not currently collect or refund money. Do not pay based on sample images or illustrative prices without verifying the seller.
اطلب من البائع فاتورة أو إثباتًا يتضمن و: Ask the seller for an invoice or evidence describing the item, condition, price, warranty and delivery. Clarify return, shipping and cost terms before committing. We do not impose one return period for all goods or imply that all private sales have the same rules as commercial suppliers.
عند وجود عيب أو اختلاف عن الوصف، وثّق ال: If there is a defect or mismatch with the description, document it, notify the seller promptly and retain the listing and proof of purchase. Consumer rights under Jordanian legislation for defective or nonconforming goods and services remain applicable according to the circumstances. A general statement such as no returns or exchanges does not remove mandatory rights.
افحص حالة المستعمل والرقم التسلسلي والبط: Inspect used goods, serial numbers, battery, accessories and disclosed defects before buying. For digital services, agree in writing on scope, deliverables, revisions, duration, ownership and cancellation. A private agreement does not reduce mandatory legal rights.
أرسل بلاغًا عبر التواصل مع رقم الطلب ورا: Submit a report through Contact with the order number, listing link and a description of the problem. Saving a report does not mean that a refund or claim has been approved. Review is manual. This does not limit your right to approach consumer protection or the competent authorities.
